package policy_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"

	api "policy/api"
	strict "policy/strict"
)

func TestJSONPolicy(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("cases.json")
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	var cases []struct { Name string; Input json.RawMessage; Strict bool }
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	for _, row := range cases {
		t.Run(row.Name, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Parallel()
			var value api.Policy
			if err := json.Unmarshal(row.Input, &value); err != nil { t.Fatalf("HTTP JSON: %v", err) }
			if value.Id != "podcast" || value.Source.Url != "playlist" { t.Fatalf("HTTP JSON lost known fields: %+v", value) }
			var config strict.Policy
			err := json.Unmarshal(row.Input, &config)
			if (err == nil) != row.Strict { t.Fatalf("strict decode: %v; want accepted=%v", err, row.Strict) }
			if err == nil && (config.Id != "podcast" || config.Source.Url != "playlist") { t.Fatalf("config lost known fields: %+v", config) }
		})
	}
}
